body.x: FŪZ Designs(fuzdesigns.com), an innovative company of electronics, unveiled Noke at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Noke is the world's first bluetooth-enabled padlock which frees users from the need for keys or combinations. Once users download the iOS or Android app, Noke automatically finds and pairs to users' Bluetooth 4.0-enabled smartphone.The compact size of this padlock fits where traditional padlocks fit. It is made with hardened steel and boron for durability. It is also water-resistant with four silicone gaskets to keep the water out and no external buttons.The battery lasts over a year of normal use. In case of discharge or not having a smartphone to operate it, its patent-pending Quick-Click technology creates a custom access code to instantly unlock the lock. It even comes with a custom chain and bike mount to neatly and securely attach Noke to the seat post.
